headline: Simple credit limit increase on a premium-tier card, exactly at the 50% maximum; clean.
solution_check: Gold Rewards is premium tier (replacements_002 and doc_015). Limit $5000, so the maximum increase is 50% = $2,500, which is what the customer asks for. Following logistics_007, the agent submits 2500 first, then checks: account age (opened 03/20/2023), CLI history (only the new request), no disputes, no pending replacement, good standing, utilization 0% ($0 balance), and payment history (3 required; 6 on time). It approves new_credit_limit 7500. This matches gold[0..12] and the replay is clean.
prior_note: Prior clean; still clean. The logistics_005 change in v1.0.1 only removed stray "$" signs from day counts.
